wants.evidence: Kahani Ka Safar's 'अग्निवंश... जिसे सदियों तक दुनिया से छिपाकर रखा गया' (100x normal); DOCUMENTARY INDUSTRIES' 'भारत का पुराना धर्म कैसे खत्म हो गया? Charvaka Philosophy' (148x); Itihaas Ki Kahani's 'हड़प्पा सभ्यता इतनी उन्नत थी फिर कैसे खत्म हो गई?' (1073x) and 'ताजमहल के 22 रहस्य जो आज भी दुनिया से छुपे हैं' (206x)

wants.topic: Origin stories of controversial Indian social structures — caste, varna, religious orthodoxy
wants.evidence: DOCUMENTARY INDUSTRIES' 'आदिमानव से जाति प्रथा तक का संपूर्ण सफर। The Untold Origin Of Caste System' (18x); Charvaka/ancient materialism video (148x) — viewers crave non-textbook explanations for how current hierarchies began

wants.topic: Civilization collapse mysteries with Indian focus — Indus Valley, Nalanda, lost cities
wants.evidence: Itihaas Ki Kahani's Indus Valley collapse (1073x); kwy true tale's Nalanda 'creation to destruction' (4x); Kahani Ka Safar's Agnivansh/shurveer forgotten lineages (100x, 15x) — 'how it ended' beats 'how it began'

wants.topic: Deep-time Indian history framed as 'complete journey' — 4.6 billion years to Indus Valley/civilization
wants.evidence: Story Plug Studio's '460 Crore Saal Ka Itihas | Dinosaur, Human Evolution, Ancient Civilization' (23x); kwy true tale's 'Earth History Documentary | Dinosaur to Human Evolution | #IndusValley' (2.6x) — evolution only works when bridged to Indian civilization

wants.topic: Specific forgotten heroes/lineages erased from mainstream memory
wants.evidence: Kahani Ka Safar's 'शूरवीर, एक ऐसे वीर योद्धा की महागाथा' (15x) and Agnivansh (100x) — named but obscure warriors/lineages outperform generic 'kings and battles'

wants.topic: Man-made catastrophes/famines under colonial or pre-colonial rule with death tolls
wants.evidence: Story Plug Studio's '1877 Ka Maha Akal | 82 Lakh Maut Ka Sach | Madras Famine' (12x) — specific numbers + 'sach/truth' framing drives clicks

gaps: Pre-Vedic/Indus Valley religious practices — what they actually worshipped before 'Hinduism' formed (Charvaka success suggests appetite)
Scientific/technological achievements of ancient India that were lost — not vague 'vimana' claims but specific metallurgy, medicine, urban planning
History of Indian philosophical debates — Buddhism vs Jainism vs Ajivika vs Charvaka vs Vedic, why some won
Regional histories outside North India — Chola naval empire, Ahom resistance, Vijayanagara's fall, Northeast kingdoms — barely touched
Women rulers/scholars beyond Rani Lakshmibai/Razia Sultana — Didda of Kashmir, Rudrama Devi, Akka Mahadevi, Lopamudra
History of Indian mathematics/astronomy from Sulba Sutras to Kerala School — with names, dates, proofs
saturated: Generic 'complete history of India' timelines (kwy true tale's 5x is low for 3.7M views — high absolute but low vsNormal)
Mughal empire standard narratives — Akbar, Aurangzeb, Taj Mahal romance (unless 'hidden secrets' angle like 22 secrets at 206x)
Freedom struggle 1857/Gandhi/Bhagat Singh — oversaturated, low differentiation
Generic dinosaur/evolution documentaries without Indian civilizational bridge (Story Plug weakest at 0.01x)
Foreign civilization documentaries — Ottoman (0.01x), Ancient China (0.08x), Egypt (11x only with 'how built pyramids' mystery angle)
Fictional royal/princess drama stories (Kahani Ka Safar weakest 0.17-0.24x) — audience rejects fiction disguised as history
Primitive human daily life/love stories (DOCUMENTARY INDUSTRIES weakest 0.13-0.16x) — too speculative, not 'Indian history'
title_patterns: "X सच जिसे सदियों/सालों तक छिपाकर रखा गया" (Truth hidden for centuries/years)
"इतनी उन्नत थी फिर कैसे खत्म हो गई?" (So advanced, yet how did it end?) — collapse mystery
"Y के Z रहस्य जो आज भी दुनिया से छुपे हैं" (Z secrets of Y still hidden from world) — numbered secrets
"Untold Origin Of X / X की अनकही उत्पत्ति" — forbidden origin stories
"Complete story: Creation to Destruction / पूरी कहानी - निर्माण से विनाश तक" — full arc framing
"Number + Shocking Fact": "82 लाख मौत", "22 रहस्य", "460 करोड़ साल", "7 शर्तें"
Question as title: "कैसे खत्म हो गया?", "कैसे बनाएं?", "क्यों नहीं जानने दिया?"
"Mahagatha / Mahakatha / Virasat" for forgotten hero/lineage sagas
